name: Kohaú Hibachi Restaurant 🍣
desc:
Welcome to Kohaú Hibachi Restaurant, a Japanese teppanyaki restaurant roleplay! 🔥

🍣 Order from the menu and watch your food be cooked in front of you!
🧑‍🍳 Apply and train to be hired as a chef!
🍡 Cook foods like sushi, serve customers, and clean the restaurant!
📈 Work up as a chef to get promoted to manager!
✨ Collect secret recipes, hibachi tricks, and uniforms!
& much more!

New Update:
🎃 Halloween Map
🤖 Table NPC Event
🍎 Fall Foods
💀 Halloween Cosmetics

How do you get a job?
⭐ Join the group!
✏️ Take an application in the "Apply" app!
📋 Attend a training in the "Train" app!
